::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
This is an inbox, not a library. An entry earns its place by carrying a
question, and it is supposed to leave: into a project's references page where
it gets read properly, or off the list with a reason. A list that only grows
has stopped working.
:::

The method for reading any of these is on the
[Reading Papers](reading-papers.qmd) page: three passes, and you stop at the
pass that answers the question. That is why every entry below names a
question. A paper with no question attached is a bookmark, and belongs
somewhere else.

Where a paper is being read to settle something in a specific project, it
moves to that project's own references page, which carries the stricter
markers for whether a claim has been verified against its source. The
[TCE-IPDE references](../projects/tce-ipde/references.qmd) page is the worked
example.

## Status markers

- 📥 **Queued.** On the list, not started.
- 📖 **Reading.** Started, and the note says which pass it is on.
- ✅ **Done.** Read here, or graduated to a project's references page. The note
  says which, and what came of it.
- ❌ **Dropped.** Not going to be read, with the reason on the entry.
